_doc: Site and map palette. Ramps validated with the dataviz checks (ordinal: monotone L, ΔL ≥ 0.06, light end ≥ 2:1 on paper, single hue); biscay/med validated as a categorical pair (CVD ΔE 21.8). heat and cold: ordinal ramps (heat more saturated than people so the two maps don't read alike); the stripes use cold[::-1] + neutral + heat[:4], L-matched arms.
